kurundī (feminine) [kurundī + ṇa + ī. Mogg, ibid. 20. Just as the words varaṇa, goda, pañcāla do not only mean "flood tide", "Godāvarī river", and "King Pañcāla" respectively, but also refer to Varaṇā city, Godāvarī village, and Pañcāla country, as stated by Pāṇini, Candra, and Kātantra teachers, this word kurundī also definitely refers to a monastery, and by metonymy to the commentary. If understood this way, it doesn"t seem necessary to separate the taddhita. For details, see Mogg. 3. Sya. 19 note.]

kulavasaṅkura: [Kulavaṃsa+aṅkura] (pu) CL=7 The tendril (tip of new creeper) of the family generation. The tendril(tip of new creeper) of one"s family.
kulavasaṭṭhapana: [Kulavaṃsa+ṭhapana] (na) CL=7 Causing to continue to exist in his family generation.
kulavasāgata: [Kulavaṃsa+āgata] (ti) CL=7 Comes from the family generation.
kulavasānugata: [Kulavaṃsa+anugata] (ti) CL=7 Follows the family circle or generation.
kulavasānupālaka: [Kulavaṃsa+anupālaka] (ti) CL=7 One who cares for the family generation.
kulavasānurūpa: [Kulavaṃsa+anurūpa] (ti) CL=7 One who is suitable for the family generation.
kulavasānussaraṇakkhaṇa: [Kulavaṃsa+anussaraṇakkhaṇa] (pu) CL=7 A period of remembering the family generation.
kulavasūpacchedabhaya: [Kulavaṃsa+upacchedabhaya] (na) CL=7 Fear of breaking the family generation.
kulavasūpacchedanabhaya: Kulavaṃsūpacchedanabhaya [kulavaṃsa+upacchedanabhaya] Fear of breaking the family generation.
kumbhīlamasa: [Kumbhīla+maṃsa] (na) CL=7 The meat of a crocodile.
kumārakasasaṭṭha: [Kumāraka+saṃsaṭṭha] (ti) CL=7 One who is closely associated with young boys.
kuppeyyu: [Kupa+ya+eyyuṃ] (kri) CL=7 Should they be angry. See - Kuppati-(2).
kuppisu: [Kupa+ya+uṃ] (kri) CL=7 They were ruined. See - Kuppati-(2).
kuruta: [Kara+o+taṃ] (kri) CL=7 [See - Kuru(3)]. May he do. May he act.
kusalabhāvasasiddhi: [Kusalabhāva+saṃsiddhi] (thī) CL=7 Completion or accomplishment of the state of wholesome deeds.
kusalamūlasaropana: [Kusalamūla+saṃropana] (thī,na) CL=7 Planting well the wholesome root. Planting well the seed of wholesome root.
kusalamūlatasampayutta: [Kusalamūla+taṃsampayutta] (ti) CL=7 The root of merit. Related to that root of merit.
kusalapaṭisayutta: [Kusala+paṭisaṃyutta] (ti) CL=7 Related to merits or wholesome states.
kusalavīmasā: [Kusala+vīmaṃsā] (thī) CL=7 The wisdom that is related to wholesome deeds.
kusalūpasahita: [Kusala+upasaṃhita] (ti) CL=7 Related to a wholesome state. Dependent on wholesome state. A cause of arising a wholesome state.
kusītasasagga: [Kusīta+saṃsagga] (pu) CL=7 Associating with a lazy person.
kuṭimaṇḍapasakiṇṇa: [Kuṭimaṇḍapa+saṃkiṇṇa] (ti) CL=7 Mixed with a monastery and pavilion.
